name: spawner2d
description: Worlds that build themselves as the camera moves: a Generator lays out rows of things from prefabs ahead of the camera, in the direction the game chooses (up for the platforms, monsters and coins of an endless climb, right for the obstacles and coins of a runner), the things left far behind are removed (Cull), and a Shooter fires prefabs on an action (bullets, arrows). It all comes from the game's prefabs, the Random of the game and the camera, so the same seed always builds the same world. The y axis points down; going up means y gets smaller.

components.name: Generator
components.description: Lays rows of a prefab ahead of the camera, in the direction (toward_x, toward_y): (0, -1) goes up (the endless climb of a platformer), (1, 0) to the right (a runner), (0, 1) down, (-1, 0) left; the axis with the bigger number counts, and y grows downwards. Rows are `ahead` units ahead of the edge of the screen that the direction points to: the first row is at `next` (its coordinate along the direction), and each row is `gap` units further than the previous one, with gap drawn between gap_min and gap_max. The row's position across the direction is drawn between across_min and across_max (x for a vertical layout, y for a horizontal one). Difficulty grows with the distance travelled (how far `next` is from `origin` along the direction): over ramp_distance units every setting that has an `_end` goes from its first value to its `_end` value (an `_end` left at -1 means no change; a ramp_distance of 0 uses the `_end` values at once). A row may be a different prefab: alt2_prefab with alt2_chance, else alt_prefab with alt_chance, else prefab; to lay out several kinds of things, give an entity of its own to each kind (platforms, monsters and coins are three Generators). A row may bring an extra prefab (a spring on a platform, a coin above it) with extra_chance, placed at the row's position moved by up to extra_across either way across the direction and by extra_along ahead along it (a negative number puts it behind); with extra_on_alt off only the usual prefab brings it (a spring does not stay in the air above a platform that moves away). row_chance is the chance that a row is built at all (a row that is not built still uses its gap); rows less than from_distance units from origin are never built. The game places the prefabs' Position; nothing the prefabs say about it matters. Needs a Camera.

components.name: Cull
components.description: The entity is destroyed when it is more than margin units outside the edge of the screen that side_x and side_y point to (0, 1: the bottom edge, as y grows downwards; 0, -1: the top; 1, 0: the right; -1, 0: the left; the axis with the bigger number counts): a platform the climber left behind, or whatever a runner left on its left (side_x -1, side_y 0). Needs a Position and a Camera.

components.name: Shooter
components.description: Fires prefab each time the action is pressed, at most once every cooldown ticks, from the entity's Position moved by (dx, dy), with the Velocity (dir_x, dir_y) times speed (units per second; y points down, so dir_y -1 fires upwards). Needs a Position.

systems.name: generate
systems.description: Builds the rows of every Generator that the camera has not yet gone past, and asks the app to create them (they appear between two ticks).

systems.name: cull
systems.description: Destroys every Cull entity that fell below the screen.

systems.name: shoot
systems.description: Fires the prefab of every Shooter whose action is pressed and whose cooldown is over.
